**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]

*[[2025 Atlantic hurricane season]]

'''Health and environment'''
*A [[botulism]] outbreak in [[Southern Italy|southern]] [[Italy]] kills three people and hospitalizes at least 17 others following the consumption of contaminated meat and vegetables in [[Diamante, Calabria|Diamante]], [[Calabria]], and [[Cagliari]], [[Sardinia]], a week prior. '''International relations'''
*[[Australia–Palestine relations]], [[International recognition of Palestine]]
**[[Prime Minister of Australia|Australian prime minister]] [[Anthony Albanese]] announces that [[Australia]] will recognise [[Palestine]] as an independent country in September. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/live/2025/aug/11/news-live-netanyahu-shameful-palestine-state-anthony-albanese-penny-wong-meteor-victoria-marles-papua-new-guinea-ntwnfb?CMP=share_btn_url&page=with%3Ablock-68995ecb8f08f4cafb5ad23f#block-68995ecb8f08f4cafb5ad23f (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Israel–Norway relations]], [[Disinvestment from Israel]]
**The [[Government Pension Fund of Norway|Norwegian Pension Fund]] divests from 11 Israeli companies and terminates its contracts with [[asset management|asset manager]]s in [[Israel]], following reports last week that it invested in an Israeli jet engine company that sold parts to the [[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]]. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/society-equity/norway-wealth-fund-terminates-israel-asset-management-contracts-2025-08-11/ (Reuters)]
